headline: Casualties Surge as Bases Change Hands Across Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the two bloodiest sectors have deepened their toll. Nevish Line added roughly 6,400 Colonial and 7,400 Warden dead in the past day, with one‑hour loss rates now accelerating to nearly 380 and 340 per hour respectively. Weathered Expanse recorded about 6,200 Colonial and 5,900 Warden casualties, its hourly rates also climbing. Both sectors show intense base turnover: Nevish Line logged 70 ownership events in 24 hours across five key positions, while Weathered Expanse saw 48 events at five forward bases. Marban Hollow and Kuura Strand each reported 17 flips, centred on Checkpoint Bua, Oster Wall, Faden Point and Talven. Linn Mercy continued its rapid pace with 13 changes at Lathair and Outwich Ranch, though its casualty flow eased slightly. Stlican Shelf added four more transitions at Briar and Breaker Town. Farranac Coast and Godcrofts produced only a handful of neutralisations and captures. The remaining regions remain largely static, with enlistment spikes persisting in the hottest zones, suggesting the current flare‑ups may sustain through the next day.
